records.text: Intel recruits heavily from the LDS—that is a fact—Latter-day Saints, Church of Latter-day Saints, and apparently they recruit from that particular campus
records.speaker: Payne Revere (viewer account; identity unverified)

appearances.snippet: "Three: intel recruits heavily from the LDS—that is a fact—Latter-day Saints, Church of Latter-day Saints. And apparently they recruit from that particular campus—which I found out—which is interesting."

verification.notes: Historical BYU reporting documents CIA and DIA recruitment in Utah and at BYU, including recruiters citing returned missionaries' language and foreign-culture experience. Later reporting also quotes former FBI recruiters denying that religion itself is targeted. The general recruitment pattern in LDS Utah is supported, but the categorical heavily-from-LDS wording and recruitment at the particular campus in context, Utah Valley University rather than BYU, were not established. The viewer source is now modeled as anonymous.

sources.title: The Daily Universe historical compilation
sources.relevance: BYU's newspaper reproduces reporting that CIA recruiters regarded Utah and BYU as productive sources because of language and foreign-culture experience.

sources.title: FBI, CIA, NSA ... BYU?
sources.relevance: Reviews documented intelligence recruitment in LDS Utah while quoting former FBI recruiters who deny targeting applicants by religion; it does not establish recruitment at UVU specifically.
